pages.lesson:
LESSON: STANDING FIRM IN FAITH (APOSTLE PAUL)

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Church
Topic 4.2: Standing firm in Faith (Apostle Paul)

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Standing firm in Faith (Apostle Paul). Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Standing firm in Faith (Apostle Paul)
2. Practise Standing firm in Faith (Apostle Paul) at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Standing firm in Faith (Apostle Paul)

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Standing firm in Faith (Apostle Paul)
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Standing firm in Faith (Apostle Paul). Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Standing firm in Faith (Apostle Paul) at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Standing firm in Faith (Apostle Paul) at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Standing firm in Faith (Apostle Paul)
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Standing firm in Faith (Apostle Paul). Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Standing firm in Faith (Apostle Paul) using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Standing firm in Faith (Apostle Paul) in the examples.
2. Explain Standing firm in Faith (Apostle Paul) to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Standing firm in Faith (Apostle Paul).
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Standing firm in Faith (Apostle Paul) using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Standing firm in Faith (Apostle Paul) important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Standing firm in Faith (Apostle Paul)
2. Practise Standing firm in Faith (Apostle Paul) at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Standing firm in Faith (Apostle Paul)

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
